amount.description: In the base currency: money in above zero, money out below. An open item's is its carrying amount.

basis.description: Why that day: history, the due date + the contact's average days late over the last 12 months; due, its due date (no history); planned, a bill's planned payment date (no history); overdue, expected before today, so today; scheduled, a batch's payment date; moved, a what-if moved it.

days_late.description: history: the contact's average days late, rounded half away from zero.

due_date.description: Its due date; absent for a batch.

id.description: The document, the recurring document or the batch.

key.description: Names it in a what-if: the document's or batch's ID, or a recurring document's ID and occurrence as <id>@YYYY-MM-DD.

kind.description: What it is: an open invoice or bill, a recurring invoice's or bill's occurrence, or an approved payment batch not yet released.

number.description: The document's or batch's number, or the recurring document's name.
